# Prompt Anatomy – Daily Workflow Library

> Free 8 copy-paste prompts, no account. Companion to the Prompt Anatomy interactive course — not a lesser copy of it. This site is the Daily Workflow Library, not the Hub.

## What it is
Let AI do 30–50% of your daily tasks. 8 exercises with ready-made templates – results in minutes.

## Who it's for
Managers, specialists, consultants, freelancers.

## Canonical site
https://www.promptanatomy.info/
